name: comparator-offset-gof
description: Goodness-of-fit companion to sim/comparator-offset-mc/ (issue #9): re-measures the preamplifier's input-referred offset at a single PVT point (nominal) and a single common mode (V_cm = 1.65 V), printing every Monte Carlo draw's V_os so an external normality check (issue #14) can run against the raw sample rather than against the aggregate sigma alone.
claim: README.md#target-specification -- Offset error <= 2 LSB untrimmed (3-sigma mismatch). This record does not re-derive sim/comparator-offset-mc/'s per-corner sigma (reused as-is); it supplies the goodness-of-fit check issue #14's acceptance criteria require before that sigma is used to extrapolate a 3-sigma yield claim.

sig_vos_mv.description: Same band as sim/comparator-offset-mc/'s sig_vos_mv check: a floor against a collapsed (mismatch-off) population and a ceiling wide enough for corner/bias-point movement. This run is nominal-only, so the check is a sanity band, not a corner-sensitivity assertion.

av_sigma_pct.description: LOAD-BEARING SELF-CHECK (identical role to sim/comparator-offset-mc/'s av_sigma_pct): proof that `alter`/`reset` preserved one mismatch draw across both DC sweep points, so voa is a real per-draw offset and not the difference of two independent populations.

mean_vos_uv.description: Population mean offset must be ~0 (circuit symmetry, sim/comparator-offset/). Same band as sim/comparator-offset-mc/, sized for this record's N=300 (tighter standard error than N=150).

evidence.mc_seed: ngspice `setseed 20260801` at the top of the control block, then 300 draws via `reset` inside a dowhile loop. Same seed value and mechanism as sim/comparator-offset-mc/ and sim/device-mismatch-mc/ (`setseed <n>` is the only one of ngspice's three seeding mechanisms that actually draws a fresh population per `reset` in this PDK; see either record's Note for the verification).
evidence.mc_sigma: 1-sigma reported directly; 3-sigma alongside it. This record's purpose is the SHAPE of the distribution (goodness-of-fit for issue #14), not a new sigma estimate -- sim/comparator-offset-mc/'s per-corner sigma (1.17926-1.19477 mV over 38 completed points) is the sigma of record, reused as-is; this run's own sig_vos_mv is reported only as a consistency check against that figure (same circuit, same method, independent draw sequence).
notes: RAW SAMPLES. Every one of the 300 draws' voa (V_os in volts) is printed to this record's log via the `print voa` line inside the dowhile loop -- see corners/<record-id>/tt_27c_3.30v.log. That is the only difference in kind from sim/comparator-offset-mc/: this deck exists to make the raw population recoverable, not to produce a new sigma claim.

WHY NOMINAL-ONLY, ONE COMMON MODE. sim/comparator-offset-mc/ already measured <1.3% corner spread of sigma(V_os) over 38/45 PVT points (par_vth lives in the PDK's fets_mm subckt, not any corner .lib section, so it is corner-invariant by construction) and the code-correlated (common-mode-dependent) question separately, at 0.19 uV / 0.00006 LSB. Neither question is re-opened here; this record checks only whether the population's SHAPE (not its corner dependence or its common-mode dependence) is consistent with the Gaussian assumption spec/comparator-budget-memo.md S3.3 and this issue's yield arithmetic both rest on.

This experiment directory is intentionally separate from sim/comparator-offset-mc/ (owned by issue #9, closed via PR #45): it does not modify that testbench or its manifest, so #9's existing per-corner record remains exactly reproducible from its own frozen netlist snapshot.
